question: A cement laboratory's water-soluble chloride titration rises after changing reagent lots, while XRF total-chlorine results remain stable. What evidence should an independent agent require to distinguish reagent blank contamination, extraction recovery and genuine cement chloride variation before any batch-release or procurement decision?
category: Cement chloride assay method and reagent-lot reconciliation
scenario: New reagent lot coincides with increased soluble-chloride titration on retained cement, without matching movement in total-chlorine screening
evidence_required: Paired retained-sample aliquots, extraction solvent volume, temperature, duration, sample mass and moisture correction
Reagent lot certificates, titrant standardization, reagent blanks, method detection limit, spike recoveries and duplicate titrations
XRF calibration, matrix correction, reference-material results, reported total versus water-soluble chloride basis, applicable product specification and laboratory method editions
answer_and_decision_guide: Preserve the suspect lot and repeat matched retained-sample tests with old and new reagent lots under controlled extraction conditions. Subtract validated method blanks and compare standardization, spikes, duplicate precision and independent reference samples. Treat XRF total chlorine and extracted soluble chloride as different measurands; apparent disagreement alone does not identify a faulty result. Refer disputed release decisions to the qualified laboratory and applicable standard, not an AI-generated threshold.
source_provenance: Seller-maintained navigation source only; independently check the current applicable cement chloride test method, product specification and laboratory quality system before relying on results.
free_first_decision: Use existing retained samples, reagent records, quality-control charts and published test-method instructions first. A paid file is unnecessary if the validated laboratory SOP resolves the discrepancy.

conditional_paid_check.authorization: Only consider an exact inventoried relevant reference after verifying edition, price, permissions and seller rights and obtaining explicit buyer approval; no automatic purchase.

model_limitations: No raw titration volumes, blank values, extraction recoveries, XRF calibration or product limits were provided; the agent cannot establish compliant chloride concentration or authorize release.
